subject: Re: Request: vulnerability scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure artifacts for SOC 2 audit
messages:
From: Brightline Compliance <security@brightline.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@fintrust.com
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Request: vulnerability scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Markus / Monica,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 scoping this week and need a compact evidence bundle from Redwood that covers your vulnerability management program for the past 12 months. Specifically Brightline is asking for:

- Scan cadence matrix (tools, frequency, owners) covering infra and container images.
- CVE closure SLA measurements (mean time to remediate by severity tier) and any SLA exceptions in the period.
- A sample artifact chain for 3 closed critical/high CVEs showing discovery, ticketing ID, remediation PR/patch, validation scan, and close timestamp.
- Any compensating control notes for legacy components where patching was deferred.

Could you produce a compact packet (<=100MB) and an index spreadsheet we can drop into our audit repo? We ideally need this by Friday 2027-11-05 for pre-review. If there are any items you can't share externally, please flag them and we can discuss an NDA/secure handoff.

Thanks —
Sana Rao
Brightline Compliance
security@brightline.com

Attachment: compliance-request-20271103.pdf (request checklist)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Brightline Compliance <security@brightline.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Sana —

Thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide a compact evidence packet by the deadline. Quick notes on scope and deliverables so expectations align:

- Scan cadence matrix: we will include nightly image scans, weekly infra host scans, and monthly dependency scans. The matrix will list tool names (TruScan, ClairRunner, internal nightly agent), owners and the timeframe covered (2026-11-01 to 2027-10-31).
- CVE SLA metrics: we'll provide aggregated MTTR by severity (critical/high/medium/low), plus the underlying ticket IDs for samples. Any SLA exceptions (e.g., third-party libs with vendor patch delays) will be flagged.
- Artifact chain: we'll include 3 sample chains (CVE-2027-1834, CVE-2027-2049, CVE-2027-0192) with redacted PR diffs where necessary and validation scan snapshots.
- Compensating controls: for our legacy analytics worker (air-gapped cluster), we'll include the compensating control checklist and an auditor-facing note.

Attachments and handoff: Monica will assemble the packet into a zipped archive and publish to a secure Drive folder. For anything sensitive we can provide an auditors-only bundle with additional access controls.

I'll attach the index and a short narrative describing our remediation workflow so your auditors can follow the chain. Monica, can you confirm you can deliver the zipped packet and the spreadsheet by EOD Thursday (2027-11-04 PST) so Brightline has a day to pre-review?

— Markus Klein
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): draft-index-vm-20271104.xlsx (will be finalized), remediation-narrative-brief.txt

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Brightline Compliance <security@brightline.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability scan cadence, SLAs, and CVE closure artifacts for SOC 2 audit

Sana / Markus —

Packet complete and uploaded. Summary below and pointers into the archive:

- File: redwood_vm_evidence_snapshot_20271103.zip (size: 82MB) — root index in /index.md
- Spreadsheet: cve-closure-summary-2027Q4.xlsx — contains MTTR by severity, ticket crosswalk, and SLA exception notes (tab: metrics).
- Sample artifacts: folder /samples/ contains three chains: CVE-2027-1834 (web-edge lib), CVE-2027-2049 (image-processing native lib), CVE-2027-0192 (container runtime). Each chain includes: initial scan export (scan.json), Jira ticket stub (JIRA-4721 etc), PR/patch link (redacted diff.txt), validation scan snapshot (postfix_scan.xml), and closure timestamp log.
- Compensating control note: /controls/legacy-analytics.md — describes compensating monitoring, throttled access, and planned sunset date (2028-02-15).

Secure link (auditor access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVM-evidence (viewers: Brightline auditors)
HubSpot reference: HS-12345

A couple of clarifications for your reviewers:
- The MTTR table includes only issue-to-closure intervals where we performed remediation (not when a vendor provided a patch). We have flagged vendor-delay cases in the exception column.
- Where PR diffs contain customer-sensitive paths we redacted only the path segments and left the diff context for verification.

If auditors need an expanded forensic bundle (full scan exports with raw hashes) we can prepare that under an auditor NDA — let us know and we'll start the request.

Thanks — will stand by for any follow-up questions.

Monica Patel
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vm_evidence_snapshot_20271103.zip (attached to internal message), cve-closure-summary-2027Q4.xlsx
